title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ava Patel
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets have had gaps in per-priority burst utilization visibility which makes it hard to evaluate whether priority tokenbuckets and burst guarantees are being consumed as intended. This PR enhances the autoscaler and observability pipelines to emit priority-aware burst metrics and adds a new utilization report used by ops and SRE to detect misconfigurations and regressions. Summary of changes: 1) Introduce priority_tokenbucket metrics (burst_capacity_available, burst_capacity_used, burst_replenish_rate) tagged by fleet_id, model_family, priority_level; 2) Update autoscaler controller to emit delta-based consumption metrics and a periodic snapshot for offline reporting; 3) Add a dedicated utilization reporting job that aggregates per-priority windows, computes 95th/50th percentiles, and surfaces over-provisioned/under-utilized pools; 4) Wire metrics through the metrics pipeline and add Grafana dashboard + alerts for anomalous burst drain patterns; 5) Tests: unit tests for tokenbucket accounting, integration tests with a small dedicated fleet simulator, and e2e smoke tests for the reporting job. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-2431) - [x] Unit and integration tests added - [x] Metrics and dashboards included - [x] Performance benchmark + no-regressions on tail latency - [x] Docs notes for Dedicated console release. Related: ENG-2431, ENG-2510, previous PRs pr-21437/pr-32148. Rationale: This improves operability and gives teams visibility into how priority bands affect burst consumption and throughput, enabling cost/latency tradeoffs and safer rollouts for priority scheduling features.

review_thread: Samir Kulkarni: Please add more guardrails around metric cardinality. We had incidents before where new tags exploded ingest costs. Suggest coarsening priority_level to low/medium/high and limiting model_family to top-20 for the report.

Ava Patel: Good call. I limited the reporting job to top-20 model families by volume and added an explicit config (metrics.cardinality.model_family_limit) with default 20. priority_level is now normalized to low/medium/high in metrics emission.
Maya Chen: Integration test failed on first run due to a race in snapshot flush. Can you add a jitter and a retry?
Ava Patel: Added exponential backoff to snapshot writes and a 50-200ms jitter. Re-ran integration tests locally and in CI.
Jordan Lee: Approving once CI is green and we add a short note in release notes about alert thresholds.
Ava Patel: Added release note entry and linked the dashboard JSON in the docs. CI green; requesting merge.
CI Bot: Integration tests (dedicated) flaky on first run; re-run successful.
